title: If the ideal of a presentation is generated by a regular sequence at a prime, the algebra is a global complete intersection near that prime
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $n\ge0$, $P=k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], $I\subseteq P$ an ideal, $S=P/I$, $\mathfrak q\subset S$ a prime ideal and $\mathfrak q'\subset P$ its inverse image under $P\to S$. Let $P_{\mathfrak q'}$ be the localization of $P$ at $\mathfrak q'$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $IP_{\mathfrak q'}$ the ideal of $P_{\mathfrak q'}$ generated by the elements $f/1$, $f\in I$. Assume that there are an integer $e\ge0$ and elements $h_1,\dots,h_e\in P_{\mathfrak q'}$ which form a regular sequence in $P_{\mathfrak q'}$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] and generate the ideal $IP_{\mathfrak q'}$. Then there is $g\in S$ with $g\notin\mathfrak q$ such that the localization $S_g$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is a global complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00SC (label lemma-lci, line 35909), implication (5) => (1): proof, second paragraph ((5) => (2): e = c = height(q') - height(q) by dimension theory) and third paragraph ((2) => (1): clearing denominators f_i' = d_i f_i, g' with I_{g'} = (f_1',...,f_c'), g'' with dim S_{g''} = dim_q Spec S = n - c by Lemma 00P2 lemma-codimension, S_g = k[x_1..x_{n+1}]/(f_1',...,f_c', x_{n+1}g'g'' - 1))

proof.text: Apply regularSequence_dimensionAtPoint to obtain e≤n and local dimension n-e.

Obtain a outside q and a presentation of S_(a*b) for every b from the local-generator presentation theorem. Apply exists_mul_away_dimension_eq inside D(a) to get b outside q and dimension dim_q Spec S. Use its presentation at that b.
Primality gives a*b outside q. The presentation has n+1 variables and e+1 equations; e≤n gives e+1≤n+1, and dimension n-e=(n+1)-(e+1). These witnesses satisfy IsGlobalCompleteIntersection.

lean.statement: theorem exists_globalCompleteIntersection_of_regularSequence (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I)) (hq : q.IsPrime) (e : ℕ) (h : Fin e → Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) (List.ofFn h)) (hgen : Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) I = Ideal.span (Set.range h)) : ∃ g : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ I), g ∉ q ∧ Algebra.IsGlobalCompleteIntersection k (Localization.Away g)
